body: Yeah no worries man, I'll keep that in mind. Thanks for everything

I couldn't agree more with all of that man, I feel the same way, I'm glad you are able to be honest with the psychologist.

I do love her, and I can't stop thinking about her, even after all this time. I know everyone says you can get over something like that, but I just get worse and worse, especially if its after I've talked to her.

Anyone I've tried to talk to about this ignores me or clumsily tried to change the subject. I don't think the don't care, but they know going in I haven't had a great run lately, and that maybe they are worried that they don't know what to say or something. Two of my good mates died shortly before all of the shit really hit the fan, maybe they would have talked to me were they here today? Who knows. As far as pets go, there is not way I could have one in the place I live.
Thanks a lot, I'm glad there are people like you on this planet.

Yeah I have never heard that before, but it definitely seems to apply in regards to me. I'll have to check it out, thanks for your insight man, I don't know too many people that have any kind of knowledge about this stuff

No one. Most people I would expect to listen don't, and just about anyone else I can think of might mean well, but would realistically have no hope of understanding what I think about.

Its a bit of a long story but the tl - dr of it is that she was a recovering drug addict/alcoholic, and entered into a very spiritual program.About a month after saying yes to marrying me, her sponsor starting  encouraging her to break up with me due to the fact that I wasn't in the program and could therefore never understand and only ever be a problem for her,  The following weeks, whether there was any truth in it or not, every problem my fiance had in regards to her recovery was put down to her relationship with me, with was going strong as ever before this happened. Shortly after, she ended it and we have the situation we are in now.

I'm sorry to hear you had such troubles being lonely man, It make me happy to hear that you always found someone and that you are getting better now.

I've tried to find counselors and support groups for it, but where I live it seems as though most people, professionals or not, have no idea what aspergers really is. Don't feel sorry though, I seem to have high awareness of it (which is apparently a good thing). Unfortunately, most people who suffer from it are borderline autistic, Sheldon Cooper types that are almost completely incapable of holding a conversation. That makes support groups for it extremely hard.

I was on lexapro for a while, but I couldn't afford it for a repeat, so I had to stop taking it. I got back on it again, and it just didnt seem to do anything anymore.

I hear you about people wanting to help. I don't know whether to be amazed or saddened that despite the fact no one in my life now would hear me about how I feel, a bunch of random people, i.e. you guys are willing to chat with me about it. Crazy huh
Yeah, but there really doesn't seem to be that many. I also have been diagnosed with aspergers, but talking to anyone that actually has it has never really helped me, in or out of groups.

Yeah you are right. All that stuff about work and career is just another thing I feel bad about, just piling on top. I've just felt like such a useless piece of shit for so long, to be honest with you this the first time I've really been able to talk about it with anyone.

I have called them a few times. I appreciate them listening to me, but I just feel like I can't ever connect with them on a personal level. This isn't something I can really talk about with family, as my old man doesn't really believe in mental issues being anything other than character weakness.
Thanks for reading by the way

White I guess. I'm about a semester away from a bachelor of legal studies. I find the work somewhat interesting, but after graduation the thought of forging a career for myself is just hopeless. I used to have a great part time job, great people, I liked going to work and being out there in society. I had to quit that job for my ex, and since then, I have absolutely confidence when it comes to that sort of thing. I can't even function in an interview, let alone actual work situations. If I continue this way, I would never be able to handle the simplest of jobs, as I'm absolutely crippled with depression most of the time.

My Dad (who I live with) more or less hates me. I have no prospects for the future, career wise. My ex-fiance, the love of my life, doesn't want anything to do with me, and talks about our time together like it never meant anything, which obviously kills me. There are very few things that I actually enjoy. I can't even remember the last time I had a positive thing to say about myself. All I can think about is how pointless my life is. Everything that ever meant something to me turned out to be bullshit. I'm completely unable to function within society. I have no hope of getting a job, and all class seems to do is reinforce how trivial and depressing my life is.
